title: HyperG: Multilevel GPU-Accelerated k-way Hypergraph Partitioner
gpu_scope: Multilevel GPU k-way partitioner for hypergraphs rather than plain graphs; same research lineage as G-kway.
notes: Hypergraph input model is a generalization beyond this problem's plain-graph scope; no public code repository was located during this pass.
collection_variant_note: Hypergraph partitioning needs an explicit reduction and objective/balance check before it can implement ordinary graph partitioning.
